versions.changelog: Financial AI validation, PRD/test-case traceability, model/agent/RAG coverage, and ClawHub search optimization.

Initial release of funcpulse - a specialist skill for business test validation and multi-repo code change analysis.

- Provides PRD and test case-driven multi-repository code change analysis.
- Automatically generates standardized Markdown business test validation reports.
- Includes full mapping between requirements, test cases, and code changes.
- Identifies and prioritizes uncovered requirements and defects, providing detailed reproduction steps and fix suggestions.
- Enforces strict report format, template usage, and file path conventions.
- Supports advanced test case traceability, cross-repository impact analysis, and defect classification.
